title: Optimal Pruning for Neural Architectures using Fisher Information Distances
abstract: arXiv:2609.16129v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A new scheme for parameter pruning is introduced, derived from the differential-geometric distance in model space. Pruning a parameter sets its value to zero, representing a displacement of the model to the hypersurface on which that parameter vanishes. The minimal distance from the unpruned model to this hypersurface is naturally computed via the geodesic distance in the model space as determined by the Fisher information metric. This distance determines the true change in the model, and its performance, under pruning. By analysing progressively more faithful approximations of this geodesic distance a natural hierarchy of optimality for pruning methods is determined. This starts with the traditional magnitude pruning, then develops into new more sophisticated and effective pruning schemes. translated_title: 基于Fisher信息距离的神经网络架构最优剪枝方法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种新的参数剪枝方案，该方案源自模型空间中的微分几何距离。剪枝一个参数即将其值设为零，这相当于模型向该参数消失的超曲面发生位移。从未剪枝模型到该超曲面的最小距离可以自然地通过模型空间中由Fisher信息度量所确定的测地线距离来计算。该距离决定了剪枝后模型的真实变化及其性能。通过分析该测地线距离逐级更加精确的近似，确定了剪枝方法的一个自然最优性层级：从传统的幅值剪枝开始，进而发展出新的更复杂且更有效的剪枝方案。该方法在MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上，针对全连接网络和视觉Transformer，在完整的0-100%剪枝率范围内进行了演示验证。
tldr: 提出一种基于Fisher信息测地线距离的神经网络剪枝新方法，通过分析测地线距离的逐级近似建立了剪枝方法的最优性层级，并在MNIST和CIFAR-10上的全连接网络与视觉Transformer上验证了其优于传统幅值剪枝的效果。
